recipe.lead: Enter the name of a Warframe, weapon, etc. to see the materials needed to build it, nested by component.
recipe.nomatch: No matching Warframe or weapon (only items built from a blueprint are listed)
recipe.empty: Pick a Warframe or weapon, or type a name.
recipe.nodata: No data. Fetch it from Data Update.
recipe.col.name: Name
recipe.more: {n} more places (see Find by Item for all)
recipe.footnote: Required is the amount for one build. Totals are the base materials and credits when every component is built too. Sources are only those in the drop tables (missions, enemies, bounties, relics, etc.); the Market and vendors are not shown.
